summary: Evolution Metals Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with YA II PN, LTD. (Yorkville) for up to $100M in convertible debentures, with an initial $20M tranche issued at 97% of par. Conversion price is the lower of $12.09 or 95% of the 5-day VWAP, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and Nasdaq exchange cap unless shareholder approval is obtained. The filing covers a financing arrangement rather than a transformative event, though the convertible structure with discount pricing and potential dilution suggests a capital return strategy. The transaction is a standby equity facility; watch for registration effectiveness and shareholder vote on exceeding the exchange cap.
